spacing_and_layout.alignment: left-aligned default, never center everything, use strict grid hierarchy

surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Crystal Glass: bg-[#121110]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#262420]
surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat solid: bg-[#121110] border border-[#262420] rounded-none. Hover state: -translate-y-1, shadow-2xl
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary CTA: bg-[#D2B57B] text-[#050505] hover:bg-[#E6CC98]. Secondary CTA: bg-transparent border border-[#262420] text-[#FAFAFA] hover:text-[#D2B57B] hover:border-[#D2B57B]

motion_and_interactions.image_reveal: framer-motion slow scale-up and fade-in (1.2 to 1 scale over 1.5s)

components_instructions.marketing_pages: Use pure HTML+Tailwind for overlapping elements. Strict asymmetry. Images must not exceed 80vh.
components_instructions.forms_and_dashboards: Use customized Shadcn components. Strip default Vercel look. Sharp corners (rounded-none).
components_instructions.buttons: Include data-testid on all buttons. Example: data-testid='book-appointment-btn'
components_instructions.inputs: data-testid on all form fields. Minimalist borders, transparent backgrounds. Example: data-testid='login-email-input'
components_instructions.charts: Use Recharts with monochrome and primary gold color palette.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement pure dark mode using the provided hex codes. No default Tailwind gray or zinc. Map Tailwind config to use these colors.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, Lato, or Syne. Install 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' from Google Fonts and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, forms) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
For the Landing page hero, use the 'hero_background' image with a bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast. Use huge, light-font weight typography for the H1.
Dashboards (User & Admin) should not use generic Shadcn cards. Strip borders, use flat rectangular layouts with subtle 1px #262420 borders. Radius must be 0px (rounded-none).
For e-commerce pages, display products using the provided cosmetic_product images. Make product grids asymmetrical using the 'bento_grid_gap' spacing where possible.
Ensure hover states explicitly declare text colors to maintain contrast.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling on the marketing/storefront pages.
